More upside remains on this burger joint
Jan 2025 • Solo
A bit disappointing given that it’s named “Gourmet” and also recommended by TripAdvisor. I ordered chicken burger. Chicken patties were home made and were fine. However very average or below average bun quality. They used ketchup in the burger (I can go to kfc for that)and for it to qualify as “gourmet” I would have preferred some other spread like tomatoes or basil pesto. Finally ambience is below average. It’s a nice cozy place but lacks any effort to bring out its character.
Written January 24, 2025
